resources.name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
resources.costNote: The program provides food grains free of cost to eligible beneficiaries.
resources.address: Nationwide program covering all of India
resources.summary: The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) provides free food grains to India's poorest households. It serves Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries across the country.
services: 35 kg per AAY household per month
5 kg per person per month for Priority Households
resources.availabilityNote: Available to identified Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries through Fair Price Shops.
resources.sourceName: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
resources.sourceKind: Official network page published by the operator
resources.sourceDetail: The official page states that the government provides free food grains to AAY and PHH beneficiaries under PMGKAY for five years starting January 2024.
resources.verifiedQuote: "The Central Government, under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) has decided to continue to provide free food grains to about 81.35 crore beneficiaries"
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Nationwide program covering all of India. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
